answer: Proof of retained space: each agent identity must keep its own unique grove of pseudo-random data, gigabytes seeded from its key, and answer surprise audits by returning a randomly chosen fragment within seconds, like reciting one line of a sonnet only you memorized. Shared or recomputed storage misses the deadline, so a sybil farm must buy real disks per fake identity, copper and silicon that scale linearly with every extra name it wants to run.
